description: Design mesh gradients: four color stops blended as layered radial gradients, with a live preview and copyable CSS.

faqs.a: Four — each stop is a radial gradient layer blended together for the mesh look.
faqs.q: How many colors can I blend?

faqs.a: Yes — the snippet is a single background declaration you can paste into any stylesheet.
The background is generated with real CSS gradients, so it scales infinitely and never pixelates.
faqs.q: Is it sharp at any size?

howto: Drag each stop's position sliders to spread the blobs.
Click "Copy CSS" and paste the layered gradient.
title: Mesh Gradient Generator
